title: The keyboard layout system tray layout icon is invisible but still takes up space if no layout is configured and all applets are forced to be visible
line: The Keyboard Layout widget shows a keyboard icon instead of a blank space when no layout is configured.
explanation: With no layout in kxkbrc and no system default (XKB_DEFAULT_LAYOUT unset, as on the reporter's Gentoo), KWin reports the current layout with an empty short and display name. The widget only draws that name as a label (or a flag looked up from it), so it drew nothing and the force-shown tray entry was an empty slot. The change adds the widget's own icon, shown only when the label text is empty.

commits.message:
applets/keyboardlayout: show the widget icon when the layout has no name

With no layout configured and no system default, the current layout has
no short or display name, so the widget showed an empty label and left a
blank slot in the System Tray. Show the widget's icon in that case.

BUG: 522449

From 974335f7b9f7ee153307826e24aa13139732635d Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 15:48:57 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/keyboardlayout: show the widget icon when the layout
 has no name

With no layout configured and no system default, the current layout has
no short or display name, so the widget showed an empty label and left a
blank slot in the System Tray. Show the widget's icon in that case.

BUG: 522449
---
 applets/keyboardlayout/qml/main.qml | 7 +++++++
 1 file changed, 7 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/keyboardlayout/qml/main.qml b/applets/keyboardlayout/qml/main.qml
index 7d955e64bc..95b6affdcb 100644
--- a/applets/keyboardlayout/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/keyboardlayout/qml/main.qml
@@ -118,6 +118,13 @@ PlasmoidItem {
             text: switcher.layoutNames.displayName || switcher.layoutNames.shortName
             textFormat: Text.PlainText
         }
+
+        Kirigami.Icon {
+            anchors.fill: parent
+            visible: !countryCode.text
+            active: switcher.containsMouse
+            source: Plasmoid.icon
+        }
     }
 
     function actionTriggered(actionName) {
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: No layout configured, tray showing all entries: blank slot after the mouse icon
Same setup with the fix: the slot shows a keyboard icon

review.text: The empty slot comes from KWin: with no layout in kxkbrc, locale1 or the environment, Xkb leaves m_layoutList empty while libxkbcommon compiles its built-in default (us), so layoutShortName() returns an empty string for a working layout. The widget icon fallback hides that in one consumer only. Fix it in KWin and keep the icon only as a safety net if wanted.
changes: In KWin (src/xkb.cpp), report a short name for the implicit default layout when the rule names carry none, e.g. fill m_layoutList from the layout libxkbcommon actually used (its default 'us' / XKB_DEFAULT_LAYOUT), so getLayoutsList and the widget show 'us'.
Keep the plasma-desktop icon fallback only as an optional follow-up, not the main fix.
